# mongosh Reference — Complete Architecture Guide

Comprehensive operational and internal analysis of mongosh Reference within MongoDB architectures.

## System Architecture & Invariants
- [HIGH] (core) mongosh Reference provides critical operational isolation and throughput guarantees.
- [HIGH] (antipatterns) Improper configuration of mongosh Reference causes query plan de-optimization under high concurrency.
